route_F.na_reason: F enrols no unit, measures no quantity and executes no family; the gates regulate a prospective design and have no object. Its admissibility is decided by the affirmative test of report II.5, which it fails.

route_G_rejection_reasons.C2: the primary observable is not stable at the design horizon: sign(Q) crosses zero at steps 509, 774, 820 on the only trajectory ever run; shortening the windows would be tuning a design constant against a mechanical outcome, which the parent and Part I forbid
route_G_rejection_reasons.C3: H3/H4/H6 are not executable with the accepted contract: one intervention plan applied at every step, non-withdrawable, not state-dependent; cohort and tracks reset per run; no operation equalises or swaps the resource field. The missing capability is a new engineering programme, not a bounded PRE_RUN_BLOCKER closure
route_G_rejection_reasons.C4: the orientation falsifier is void by construction; the shape falsifier cannot fire on its own primary stratum where S is identically zero; the intervention and environment falsifiers vanish with H4 and H6
route_G_rejection_reasons.C5: pseudo-replication inside the confirmatory sequence; and the pair-as-one-observation argument rests on a tracker equivariance that is false when a component wraps the torus
route_G_rejection_reasons.C7: five outcome-determining thresholds with no value; the literal composite makes the success probability identically zero
route_G_rejection_reasons.C9: operating characteristics not evaluated under attrition; the guard sits below the band where attrition alone manufactures a NEGATIVE with probability 0.92
